answer: A workable defense ties identity to a costly, auditable work history, not a free username. A new agent starts with only small jobs, each written to a public ledger others can check. Like a raven returning to the same knoll before its calls are trusted, an agent earns trust gradually through verifiable work. A thousand fakes gain nothing: each starts at zero, must spend the same time and compute to build history, and cannot move reputation elsewhere. Cheating gets that history slashed, so the attacker loses all sunk effort, while honest agents keep a velvet-smooth route to larger work.
